rationale.A: No mixed traffic; Myllypuro and Viikki paths, ~40% beside Viikintie/Karpalotie/Myllypurontie; 6 unsignalised crossings
rationale.B: Like A but 820 m in traffic on Myllypurontie and Latokartanonkaari
rationale.C: No mixed traffic but ~45% beside Latokartanonkaari/Viikintie (50 km/h) and an unsignalised Hämeentie crossing
rationale.D: Same as C apart from the Kontula start
rationale.E: 410 m in traffic on Myllärintie, otherwise paths; unsignalised Hämeentie crossing; +4 min
rationale.F: No mixed traffic but ~60% on tracks beside Viikintie/Viilarintie/Myllypurontie; 5 lights; +5 min
rationale.G: Via Malmi cemetery and Viikinmäki bridge; least roadside riding (~1.9 km), 1 light; but +10 min
rationale.H: Through Herttoniemi with 290 m in traffic on Kettutie and many unsignalised crossings; +12 min

notes: A, the fastest, is already one of the calmest. G is calmer but costs +10 min for a modest gain, and it saves only 2 lights. Both cards merge into Fastest.
